remarks:
Your getaway starts here! This 3.5-acre property is ready for your RV, weekend retreat, or future home. A gravel driveway leads you into a private setting with a 12' x 26' shed equipped with electric, plus an additional 8' x 12' shed with water. An RV electric hookup is already in place, making it easy to bring your home away from home and start enjoying the property right away.

Looking for more than an RV site? There is plenty of room to build your dream home or create your own private camp. The larger  shed could even be transformed into a cozy small camp or getaway space. Whether you're looking for a place to relax, enjoy the outdoors, store your recreational equipment, or plan for the future, this property offers plenty of possibilities. Come take a look and start imagining what you can create!
